suggested_change: Criterion 1: Allow 'Unknown—participant identity not disclosed' as valid state. Criterion 2: Only require explicit score-change notation when evidence materially changed; document 'Score stable at 6/10 based on consistent evidence' as compliant. Criterion 3: Accept 'improvement target not yet articulated' as valid reason for 4/10 (low but not vague). Criterion 4: Distinguish between 'vague' (unacceptable) and 'open-ended discovery questions' (acceptable if aligned to MEDDICC stage).
